request.body: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Instance><Job><Priority>9</Priority><Tasks><SQL><Name>AnonymousSQLTask</Name><Config><Property><Name>type</Name><Value>sql</Value></Property></Config><Query>SELECT pos FROM (SELECT pos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pos) AS rn FROM (SELECT posexplode(split(repeat('a,', 15000), ',')) AS (pos, v)) t) u WHERE rn BETWEEN 10001 AND 10005;</Query></SQL></Tasks></Job></Instance>
